cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Scalp

cards.question: Layers
cards.answer: Skin, dense connective tissue, aponeurosis, loose areolar tissue and pericranium (SCALP).

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Protects the calvaria and contains vessels, nerves, hair follicles and connective tissues.

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Loose areolar tissue is the 'danger area' because infection or blood can spread widely and communicate with intracranial venous channels.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Frontal bone

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with parietal, sphenoid, ethmoid, nasal, maxillary, lacrimal and zygomatic bones.

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Frontal squama, orbital plates, supraorbital margins/notches and frontal sinus region.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Forms the forehead, roofs of the orbits and part of the anterior cranial fossa.

cards.question: Orientation
cards.answer: Squamous part is anterior; orbital plates project posteriorly to form orbital roofs.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Superior sagittal sinus

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Runs in the attached superior margin of the falx cerebri in the midline.

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Receives superior cerebral veins and CSF via arachnoid granulations; drains posteriorly toward the confluence of sinuses.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Lies between layers of dura along the superior midline of the cranial cavity.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Falx cerebri

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Sickle-shaped vertical fold of dura mater between the cerebral hemispheres.

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Attached anteriorly to crista galli and posteriorly to tentorium cerebelli; superior margin attaches to skull.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Superior sagittal sinus lies in its attached superior margin; inferior sagittal sinus lies in its free inferior margin.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Partially separates and stabilises the cerebral hemispheres.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Grey matter of frontal lobe

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Cerebral cortex composed predominantly of neuronal cell bodies, dendrites and synapses.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Frontal cortical regions contribute to executive function, behaviour, motor planning and voluntary movement.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Forms the superficial cortex overlying the subcortical white matter.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: White matter of frontal lobe

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Bundles of myelinated axons beneath the cerebral cortex.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Carries association, commissural and projection fibres connecting frontal cortex with other brain regions.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Lies deep to frontal cortical grey matter.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Orbital fat

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Cushions and supports the globe, extraocular muscles, nerves and vessels within the orbit.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Fills spaces between orbital contents within the bony orbit.

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Can be involved in orbital inflammation, trauma and proptosis-related pathology.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Optic nerve (CN II)

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Special sensory fibres from retinal ganglion cells; functionally part of the CNS rather than a peripheral nerve.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Leaves the orbit through the optic canal and continues to the optic chiasm.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Carries visual afferent information from the retina.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Lesion of one optic nerve causes ipsilateral monocular visual loss and an afferent pupillary defect.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Nasal septum

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Formed mainly by perpendicular plate of ethmoid, vomer and septal cartilage.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Divides the nasal cavity into right and left passages and supports nasal airflow.

cards.question: Blood supply
cards.answer: Rich vascular supply including Kiesselbach's area anteriorly.

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Septal deviation can obstruct airflow; anterior septum is a common site of epistaxis.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Superior nasal concha

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Curved bony projection from the lateral nasal wall that increases mucosal surface area and creates a nasal meatus.

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Superior part of lateral nasal wall, over the superior meatus.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Promotes warming, humidification and turbulence of inspired air.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Middle nasal concha

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Curved bony projection from the lateral nasal wall that increases mucosal surface area and creates a nasal meatus.

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Middle part of lateral nasal wall, over the middle meatus.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Promotes warming, humidification and turbulence of inspired air.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Inferior nasal concha

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Curved bony projection from the lateral nasal wall that increases mucosal surface area and creates a nasal meatus.

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Inferior lateral nasal wall, over the inferior meatus.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Promotes warming, humidification and turbulence of inspired air.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Ethmoid sinus

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Multiple ethmoidal air cells within the ethmoid bone.

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Anterior and middle cells drain to the middle meatus; posterior cells drain to the superior meatus.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Between nasal cavity and orbit; separated from orbit by the thin lamina papyracea.

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Ethmoid sinus infection can spread to the orbit because of the thin medial orbital wall.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Maxillary sinus

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Largest paranasal sinus, within the body of the maxilla.

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Drains into the middle meatus via the hiatus semilunaris region.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Roof forms floor of orbit; floor relates closely to roots of upper premolar/molar teeth.

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: High drainage opening can impair clearance; dental disease may spread into the sinus.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Zygomatic bone

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with frontal, sphenoid, temporal and maxillary bones.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Forms the prominence of the cheek and contributes to lateral orbital wall and floor.

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Frontal, temporal and maxillary processes; zygomaticofacial foramen.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Temporalis muscle

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Elevates the mandible; posterior fibres retract the mandible.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Deep temporal nerves from mandibular division of trigeminal nerve (V3).

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Temporal fossa and deep surface of temporal fascia.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Coronoid process and anterior border of ramus of mandible.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Masseter muscle

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Elevates the mandible; superficial fibres also assist protrusion.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Masseteric nerve from mandibular division of trigeminal nerve (V3).

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Zygomatic arch and adjacent zygomatic bone.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Lateral surface of ramus and angle of mandible.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Buccinator muscle

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Compresses cheek against teeth, keeping food between occlusal surfaces; assists blowing and sucking.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Buccal branches of facial nerve (CN VII).

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Alveolar processes of maxilla and mandible opposite molars and pterygomandibular raphe.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Blends with orbicularis oris at the angle of the mouth.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Hard palate (maxilla bone)

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Anterior hard palate is formed mainly by palatine processes of the maxillae.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Separates oral and nasal cavities and provides a rigid surface for mastication and speech.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Nasal cavity lies superiorly and oral cavity inferiorly.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Molar tooth

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Crushes and grinds food during mastication.

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Composed of crown, neck and roots; enamel covers crown, dentine surrounds pulp, cementum covers root.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Maxillary molar roots may lie close to the floor of the maxillary sinus.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Buccal mucosa

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Non-keratinised stratified squamous mucosa lining the inner cheek.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Protects underlying tissues and provides a moist lining for the oral cavity.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Parotid duct opens into buccal mucosa opposite the maxillary second molar.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Mucosa of hard palate

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Predominantly keratinised stratified squamous masticatory mucosa tightly bound to underlying periosteum.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Resists mechanical stress during mastication.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Covers the bony hard palate separating oral and nasal cavities.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Tongue intrinsic muscles

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Alter the shape of the tongue for speech, swallowing and manipulation of food.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Hypoglossal nerve (CN XII).

cards.question: Components
cards.answer: Superior longitudinal, inferior longitudinal, transverse and vertical intrinsic muscles.

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Arise within the tongue from connective tissue and septal structures rather than from bone.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Insert into the substance and mucosa of the tongue.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Mylohyoid muscle

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Elevates the floor of mouth and hyoid during swallowing; can assist mandibular depression when hyoid is fixed.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Nerve to mylohyoid from inferior alveolar nerve (V3).

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Mylohyoid line of mandible.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Median mylohyoid raphe and body of hyoid.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Sublingual salivary gland

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Produces predominantly mucous saliva.

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Floor of mouth beneath mucosa, superior to mylohyoid and lateral to genioglossus.

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Multiple small ducts open along the sublingual fold; a larger duct may join the submandibular duct.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Parasympathetic secretomotor fibres from facial nerve via chorda tympani, lingual nerve and submandibular ganglion.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Genioglossus muscle

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Protrudes the tongue; depresses central tongue; unilateral action deviates tongue to opposite side.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Hypoglossal nerve (CN XII).

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Superior mental spine of mandible.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Entire length of tongue and body of hyoid.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Geniohyoid muscle

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Pulls hyoid anterosuperiorly and shortens floor of mouth; can assist mandibular depression.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: C1 fibres travelling with hypoglossal nerve (CN XII).

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Inferior mental spine of mandible.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Body of hyoid.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Digastric muscle

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Elevates hyoid during swallowing; with hyoid fixed, assists depression of mandible.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Anterior belly: nerve to mylohyoid (V3). Posterior belly: digastric branch of facial nerve (CN VII).

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Anterior belly: digastric fossa of mandible. Posterior belly: mastoid notch of temporal bone.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Intermediate tendon anchored to hyoid by fascial sling.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Platysma muscle

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Tenses skin of neck and depresses lower lip/mandible slightly.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Cervical branch of facial nerve (CN VII).

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Superficial fascia over upper pectoral and deltoid regions.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Inferior border of mandible and skin/subcutaneous tissues of lower face.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Parietal bone
cards.label: A

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with frontal, occipital, temporal, sphenoid and opposite parietal bone.
cards.label: A

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Forms much of the superior and lateral cranial vault.
cards.label: A

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Frontal bone
cards.label: B

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with parietal, sphenoid, ethmoid, nasal, maxillary, lacrimal and zygomatic bones.
cards.label: B

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Forms forehead, orbital roofs and anterior cranial fossa.
cards.label: B

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Nasal bone
cards.label: C

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with frontal bone, maxilla and opposite nasal bone.
cards.label: C

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Forms the bony bridge of the nose.
cards.label: C

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Ethmoid bone
cards.label: D

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with frontal, sphenoid, vomer, nasal, maxillary, lacrimal, palatine bones and inferior nasal conchae.
cards.label: D

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Cribriform plate, crista galli, perpendicular plate and ethmoidal labyrinths.
cards.label: D

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Contributes to anterior cranial floor, nasal septum and medial orbital wall.
cards.label: D

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Sphenoid bone
cards.label: E

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Central skull bone articulating with frontal, parietal, temporal, occipital, ethmoid, zygomatic, vomer and palatine bones.
cards.label: E

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Body, greater/lesser wings, pterygoid processes and sella turcica.
cards.label: E

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Pituitary gland sits in hypophyseal fossa of the sella turcica.
cards.label: E

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Occipital bone
cards.label: F

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with parietal and temporal bones and atlas.
cards.label: F

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Foramen magnum, occipital condyles, external occipital protuberance and clivus contribution.
cards.label: F

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Forms posterior cranial vault and much of posterior cranial fossa.
cards.label: F

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Maxilla
cards.label: G

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with multiple facial bones and contributes to hard palate, orbit and nasal cavity.
cards.label: G

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Alveolar process, palatine process, infraorbital foramen and maxillary sinus.
cards.label: G

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Houses upper teeth and forms much of the midface.
cards.label: G

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Palatine bone
cards.label: H

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with maxilla, sphenoid, ethmoid, vomer, inferior nasal concha and opposite palatine bone.
cards.label: H

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Horizontal plate forms posterior part of hard palate; perpendicular plate contributes to lateral nasal wall.
cards.label: H

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Mandible
cards.label: I

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with temporal bones at temporomandibular joints.
cards.label: I

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Body, ramus, angle, coronoid process, condylar process, mental foramen and mandibular foramen.
cards.label: I

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Supports lower teeth and provides attachments for muscles of mastication and floor of mouth.
cards.label: I

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Hyoid bone
cards.label: K

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Does not articulate directly with other bones; suspended by muscles and ligaments.
cards.label: K

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Body, greater horns and lesser horns.
cards.label: K

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Located in anterior neck around C3 level between mandible and thyroid cartilage.
cards.label: K

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Atlas
cards.label: L

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with occipital condyles superiorly and axis inferiorly.
cards.label: L

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Anterior/posterior arches, lateral masses and transverse foramina; no body or spinous process.
cards.label: L

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Supports skull and permits nodding at atlanto-occipital joints.
cards.label: L

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Axis
cards.label: M

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with atlas superiorly and C3 inferiorly.
cards.label: M

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Dens (odontoid process), body, bifid spinous process and transverse foramina.
cards.label: M

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Dens acts as pivot for rotation of atlas and head.
cards.label: M

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Frontal sinus
cards.label: a

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Within frontal bone above the nasal root and orbits.
cards.label: a

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Drains to the middle meatus via frontonasal pathway.
cards.label: a

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Close to anterior cranial fossa and orbit.
cards.label: a

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Sphenoidal sinus
cards.label: b

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Within body of sphenoid bone.
cards.label: b

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Drains into sphenoethmoidal recess.
cards.label: b

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Pituitary gland lies superiorly; cavernous sinus and internal carotid arteries lie laterally.
cards.label: b

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Provides a transsphenoidal surgical route to the pituitary.
cards.label: b

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cerebrum
cards.label: A

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Responsible for higher cognition, conscious sensation, voluntary movement, language and behaviour.
cards.label: A

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Two cerebral hemispheres with cortex, white matter and deep nuclei.
cards.label: A

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Diencephalon (hypothalamus and thalamus)
cards.label: B

cards.question: Components
cards.answer: Includes thalamus and hypothalamus around the third ventricle.
cards.label: B

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Thalamus relays major sensory/motor information; hypothalamus regulates autonomic, endocrine and homeostatic functions.
cards.label: B

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Midbrain
cards.label: C

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Upper part of brainstem between diencephalon and pons.
cards.label: C

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contains pathways and nuclei involved in eye movements, visual/auditory reflexes and motor control.
cards.label: C

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Pons
cards.label: D

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Middle part of brainstem between midbrain and medulla.
cards.label: D

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contains ascending/descending tracts and nuclei involved in facial sensation/movement, hearing, balance and respiratory modulation.
cards.label: D

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Medulla oblongata
cards.label: E

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Inferior brainstem between pons and spinal cord.
cards.label: E

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contains vital autonomic centres and pathways for cardiovascular, respiratory and reflex functions.
cards.label: E

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Superior sagittal sinus

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Attached superior margin of falx cerebri.

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Drains cerebral veins and CSF toward confluence of sinuses.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Tentorium cerebelli

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Horizontal dural fold separating cerebellum from occipital lobes.

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Attaches to occipital bone, petrous temporal bone and sphenoid; surrounds tentorial notch.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Supports occipital lobes and partitions posterior cranial fossa.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Corpus callosum; a) body, b) genu, c) splenium

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Major commissural fibre bundle connecting the two cerebral hemispheres.

cards.question: Parts
cards.answer: Genu anteriorly, body centrally and splenium posteriorly; rostrum lies anteroinferiorly.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Enables interhemispheric communication.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Anterior commissure

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Small commissural fibre bundle crossing anterior wall of third ventricle region.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Connects parts of temporal lobes and olfactory-related regions across hemispheres.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Interthalamic adhesion

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Variable midline connection between medial surfaces of the two thalami across the third ventricle.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contains little or no major commissural fibre function; may be absent.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Posterior commissure

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Commissural fibres crossing near posterior wall of third ventricle above cerebral aqueduct.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Important in bilateral pupillary light reflex pathways.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Body of the fornix

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Paired white-matter tract forming part of the fornix beneath corpus callosum.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Major output pathway from hippocampus toward mammillary bodies and septal regions.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Septum pellucidum

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Thin double membrane between corpus callosum and fornix.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Separates the anterior horns of the lateral ventricles.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Medial thalamus

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Medial portion of thalamus forming part of lateral wall of third ventricle.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Thalamic nuclei participate in sensory, motor, limbic and cognitive relay functions.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Pineal body (pineal gland)

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Posterior diencephalon, attached to roof of third ventricle.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Secretes melatonin and contributes to circadian rhythm regulation.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Pituitary gland (hypophysis)

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Sits in hypophyseal fossa of sella turcica, connected to hypothalamus by infundibulum.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Major endocrine gland controlling multiple hormonal axes.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Optic chiasm lies superiorly; sphenoidal sinus lies inferiorly.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Mammillary body

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Small rounded hypothalamic structure on inferior brain surface.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Part of limbic memory circuitry; receives hippocampal input via fornix.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Tectum of midbrain

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Dorsal midbrain containing superior and inferior colliculi.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Superior colliculi mediate visual orienting reflexes; inferior colliculi participate in auditory pathways.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Superior (anterior) medullary velum

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Thin sheet of white matter forming part of roof of upper fourth ventricle.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Extends between superior cerebellar peduncles.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cerebellum

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Coordinates movement, balance, posture and motor learning.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Posterior to pons and medulla, inferior to tentorium cerebelli.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Pons

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Brainstem between midbrain and medulla.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contains relay nuclei, cranial nerve nuclei and major tracts; contributes to respiratory control.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Optic nerve (CN II)

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Passes from retina through optic canal to optic chiasm.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Vision.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Ipsilateral monocular blindness with afferent pupillary defect.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Third ventricle

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Midline cavity of diencephalon between the thalami.

cards.question: Connections
cards.answer: Communicates with lateral ventricles via interventricular foramina and fourth ventricle via cerebral aqueduct.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contains and conducts cerebrospinal fluid.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Fourth ventricle

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Between pons/upper medulla anteriorly and cerebellum posteriorly.

cards.question: Connections
cards.answer: Receives CSF from cerebral aqueduct and continues into central canal; communicates with subarachnoid space through median and lateral apertures.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contains and conducts cerebrospinal fluid.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cerebral aqueduct (aqueduct of Sylvius)

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Narrow channel through midbrain.

cards.question: Connections
cards.answer: Connects third and fourth ventricles.

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Obstruction can cause non-communicating hydrocephalus.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Interventricular foramen

cards.question: Also called
cards.answer: Foramen of Monro.

cards.question: Connections
cards.answer: Connects each lateral ventricle with the third ventricle.

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Obstruction can enlarge one or both lateral ventricles depending on site.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Spinal cord

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Continuation of medulla through foramen magnum within vertebral canal.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Carries ascending sensory and descending motor pathways and mediates spinal reflexes.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Larynx

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Maintains airway, protects lower respiratory tract during swallowing and produces phonation.

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Anterior neck between pharynx and trachea, approximately C3–C6.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Superior nasal concha
cards.label: a

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Superior lateral nasal wall above the superior meatus.
cards.label: a

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Increases surface area and turbulence for warming/humidifying inspired air.
cards.label: a

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Middle nasal concha
cards.label: b

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Lateral nasal wall above the middle meatus.
cards.label: b

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Increases surface area and helps direct airflow around paranasal sinus drainage pathways.
cards.label: b

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Inferior nasal concha
cards.label: c

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Inferior lateral nasal wall above the inferior meatus.
cards.label: c

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Increases surface area and turbulence for air conditioning.
cards.label: c

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Opening of auditory (pharyngotympanic/Eustachian) tube
cards.label: d

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Lateral wall of nasopharynx.
cards.label: d

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Connects nasopharynx to middle ear and equalises pressure across tympanic membrane.
cards.label: d

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Salpingopharyngeal fold
cards.label: e

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Mucosal fold over salpingopharyngeus muscle descending from auditory tube region.
cards.label: e

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Salpingopharyngeus elevates pharynx during swallowing and may assist opening of auditory tube.
cards.label: e

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Orbicularis oris muscle
cards.label: f

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Closes and protrudes lips; important in speech, sucking and controlling oral opening.
cards.label: f

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Facial nerve (CN VII).
cards.label: f

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Complex fibres from maxilla, mandible and surrounding perioral muscles/modiolus.
cards.label: f

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Skin and mucosa of lips.
cards.label: f

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Incisor tooth
cards.label: g

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Cuts food during biting.
cards.label: g

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Crown with chisel-shaped edge and usually a single root.
cards.label: g

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Soft palate
cards.label: h

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Elevates during swallowing to close nasopharynx and contributes to speech.
cards.label: h

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Muscular fibrous fold extending posteriorly from hard palate.
cards.label: h

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Motor mainly via pharyngeal plexus (vagus) except tensor veli palatini via V3; sensory via trigeminal pathways.
cards.label: h

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Uvula
cards.label: i

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Midline projection from posterior free margin of soft palate.
cards.label: i

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Moves with soft palate during swallowing and phonation.
cards.label: i

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Tongue
cards.label: k

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Manipulates food, contributes to swallowing, taste and speech.
cards.label: k

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Motor via hypoglossal nerve except palatoglossus via vagus; sensory/taste innervation varies by region.
cards.label: k

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Foramen caecum
cards.label: l

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Small pit on dorsum of tongue at apex of sulcus terminalis.
cards.label: l

cards.question: Embryology
cards.answer: Marks the embryological origin of the thyroglossal duct and thyroid descent.
cards.label: l

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Lingual septum
cards.label: m

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Midline fibrous partition within the tongue.
cards.label: m

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Provides internal support and separates right and left tongue musculature.
cards.label: m

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Genioglossus muscle
cards.label: n

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Protrudes tongue and depresses its central part; unilateral action deviates tongue contralaterally.
cards.label: n

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Hypoglossal nerve (CN XII).
cards.label: n

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Superior mental spine of mandible.
cards.label: n

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Tongue substance and body of hyoid.
cards.label: n

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Geniohyoid muscle
cards.label: o

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Pulls hyoid anterosuperiorly and assists mandibular depression.
cards.label: o

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: C1 fibres via hypoglossal nerve.
cards.label: o

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Inferior mental spine of mandible.
cards.label: o

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Body of hyoid.
cards.label: o

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Mylohyoid muscle
cards.label: p

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Elevates floor of mouth and hyoid during swallowing; assists mandibular depression.
cards.label: p

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Nerve to mylohyoid from V3.
cards.label: p

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Mylohyoid line of mandible.
cards.label: p

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Median raphe and body of hyoid.
cards.label: p

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Palatine tonsil
cards.label: q

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Tonsillar fossa between palatoglossal and palatopharyngeal arches.
cards.label: q

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Part of Waldeyer's ring; contributes to mucosal immune surveillance.
cards.label: q

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Tonsillar bed is highly vascular; glossopharyngeal nerve lies nearby.
cards.label: q

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Laryngopharynx
cards.label: r

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Part of pharynx posterior to larynx, extending roughly from epiglottis/hyoid region to lower border of cricoid cartilage.
cards.label: r

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Conducts food toward oesophagus and air toward laryngeal inlet.
cards.label: r

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Epiglottis
cards.label: I

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Leaf-shaped elastic cartilage forming part of laryngeal inlet.
cards.label: I

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Helps protect the airway during swallowing by directing the bolus away from the laryngeal inlet.
cards.label: I

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Attached inferiorly to thyroid cartilage by thyroepiglottic ligament and to hyoid by hyoepiglottic ligament.
cards.label: I

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Thyroid cartilage
cards.label: II

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Largest laryngeal cartilage, formed by two laminae meeting anteriorly.
cards.label: II

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Protects vocal apparatus and provides attachment for vocal folds and laryngeal muscles.
cards.label: II

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Superior/inferior horns, oblique line and laryngeal prominence.
cards.label: II

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cricoid cartilage
cards.label: III

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Complete ring of hyaline cartilage with narrow anterior arch and broad posterior lamina.
cards.label: III

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Maintains airway and supports arytenoid cartilages.
cards.label: III

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Located inferior to thyroid cartilage and superior to first tracheal ring.
cards.label: III

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Median thyrohyoid ligament
cards.label: IV

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Extends between superior border of thyroid cartilage and hyoid bone in the midline.
cards.label: IV

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contributes to suspension of larynx from hyoid.
cards.label: IV

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cricothyroid ligament
cards.label: V

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Connects cricoid and thyroid cartilages; median part forms cricothyroid membrane/ligament.
cards.label: V

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Stabilises the laryngeal framework.
cards.label: V

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Site used for emergency cricothyrotomy.
cards.label: V

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Transverse arytenoid muscle
cards.label: VI

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Adducts arytenoid cartilages, closing the posterior part of rima glottidis.
cards.label: VI

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Recurrent laryngeal nerve (CN X).
cards.label: VI

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Posterior surface of one arytenoid cartilage.
cards.label: VI

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Posterior surface of opposite arytenoid cartilage.
cards.label: VI

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Vocal fold
cards.label: VII

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Mucosal fold containing vocal ligament and vocalis muscle.
cards.label: VII

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Vibrates for phonation and closes the glottis for airway protection.
cards.label: VII

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Motor control of intrinsic laryngeal muscles mainly via recurrent laryngeal nerve; sensory below folds via recurrent laryngeal nerve.
cards.label: VII

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Vestibular fold
cards.label: VIII

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Superior mucosal fold containing vestibular ligament.
cards.label: VIII

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Helps protect the airway and contributes to closure of laryngeal inlet; not the primary sound-producing fold.
cards.label: VIII

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Lies superior to the true vocal fold.
cards.label: VIII

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Ventricle of the larynx
cards.label: IX

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Recess between vestibular fold superiorly and vocal fold inferiorly.
cards.label: IX

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Allows independent movement of the two folds and communicates with the laryngeal saccule.
cards.label: IX

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Trachea
cards.label: X

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Conducts air between larynx and bronchi.
cards.label: X

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Fibrocartilaginous tube supported by C-shaped hyaline cartilage rings and posterior trachealis muscle.
cards.label: X

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Begins inferior to cricoid cartilage around C6 and descends into thorax.
cards.label: X
